text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install all-way stop control at the intersection of Dockside Drive and Knapp Lane. Based on the assessment undertaken, the installation of all-way stop control is recommended and should enhance safety for all road users.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Referred Item TE31.58 to the General Manager, Transportation Services for consultation with George Brown College and report back to the May 28, 2026 meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council.
